+    (OUT / "spec.json").write_text(json.dumps(robot.spec(), indent=2))

+        raise RuntimeError("the calibrated overhead camera did not return depth")
+    (OUT / "observations" / "start_depth.npy").parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    np.save(OUT / "observations" / "start_depth.npy", depth)
+

+    # The reset pose points straight down; use the measured orientation to
+    # preserve its exact convention throughout the task.

+        n = max(1, int(math.ceil(distance / MAX_WAYPOINT)))
